### ClearPendingSteps() {#clearpendingsteps}

Drops everything the queue has lined up except the step running right now, so a block
enqueued next replaces the rest of the run instead of extending it.


### SelectNextStep() {#selectnextstep}

Override to change which queued step runs next. Whatever this returns is what the manager
runs and what it removes when that step reports complete, so it must be a queued step.

